title: apex.rule.firings
description: Internal stub topic produced by agent-rule and consumed by agent-alert. The alert producer merges these firings with the PD score from ai-copilot-svc and re-emits the canonical alert on apex.regulatory.events.

firing_id.description: Producer-side idempotency token. agent-alert dedupes by content hash, but this id is the authoritative event identifier.

rule_version.description: Version of the rule that fired (mirrors Rule.version in rules/types.ts; integer accepted for legacy rules, string preferred going forward).

reason.description: AlertSpec.title from rules/types.ts — the human-readable rule label.

evidence.description: Optional bag of indicator → value pairs that contributed to the firing. Keys are indicator ids; values are numbers or null.
